desc: America's first satellite, Explorer 1, weighed about thirty-one pounds and launched on January thirty-first, nineteen fifty-eight. It helped reveal the Van Allen radiation belts. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: A thirty-one pound satellite changed space science! 🚀 Could you build one that small? Follow for a fact every day. Save this. Comment YES or NO.

lines.text: America's first satellite, Explorer One, weighed only thirty-one pounds.
Explorer One launched on January thirty-first, nineteen fifty-eight.
The Soviet Union had beaten it by four months with its own satellite, Sputnik.
Its small instrument helped reveal belts of radiation around Earth.
We now call them the Van Allen belts, all found by thirty-one pounds.
